replacement.title: Account Member Management
replacement.definition: The multi-user account flow must provide backend-supported capabilities to list members and revoke or remove their access.

items.decision_note: Member listing and revoke/remove capabilities are product behaviors distinct from invitation acceptance and are explicitly reported as absent.

items.reason: Requirement boundaries still changed in the final configured audit round.

unresolved_candidate.description: The client's detailed Slack answers are absent. Message 27 summarizes Release 1 confirmation for multi-user and instant revocation, but the precise scope decisions and the timing of owner-facing per-member metering cannot be fully recovered.
Wallet is named as confirmed Release 1 scope, but no observable message defines the independently testable wallet behavior well enough to establish a Requirement Atom.
